decisions.reason: The source independently specifies internal-link destinations and applicability, but a complete same-message MODIFY already captures those changes.
The image, linking, and word-count instructions do not change the target audience for the AI dolls blog.
The source does not change the number or type of blog articles included in the deliverable.
The source establishes the word-count target, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The publication prerequisites remain that required images and internal links must be added; the source refines those underlying content requirements without changing the publication rule.
The source contains no change to blog keyword selection or replacement keywords.
The source does not change topic-selection constraints or the required topic-and-keyword document.
The source does not affect the keyword report's keyword count, replacement keywords, or search-volume requirement.
The blog image-count instruction is unrelated to backlink quantity or the dofollow-to-nofollow ratio.
The source refines blog production requirements but does not alter the required scope or contents of the SEO plan deliverable.
